svg.title: MatVecVectorKernel on gate_up
svg.text: MatVecVectorKernel, BF16, on gate_up (17,920 × 1,536) with norm and SwiGLU
RowsPerWarp = 2 · kLoadsInFlight = 128 B / 16 B / 2 = 4 · vectors = 1,536 / 8 = 192 · 128 threads per block
one row: chunk v (8 BF16 weights, one uint4) is read by lane v % 32
Lane 3 of warp 0 (threadIdx.x = 3) in order; the amber outline above is its chunks, the same in both rows.
Dot8(w, a, b): uint4 w = 4 words of two BF16 weights; a, b = x[8v .. 8v+7], normalized; products summed
norm prologue: the block sums x's squares (every block the same) and computes inverse_rms
warp_index picks the warp's RowsPerWarp rows
each pass issues every load first: kLoadsInFlight chunks of each row
then reads x's 8 values per chunk, normalizes them and adds a Dot8 for each row
WarpSum gives every lane the row's sum; lane 0 stores SiLU(gate) × up
